New concrete catalyst: expanded Slingshot III maritime-domain-awareness contract with the US Office of Naval Research (announced 9/14, six new NewSat Mark VI satellites over 18 months), driving a +3.9% move on 9/25 to ~$6.17. Opportunity-tier (market cap ~$949M); sized to the available cash above the 2% buffer floor (~$12.33), the binding constraint today, funded by today's DUOL sector-cap trim proceeds. Revenue growth off a small absolute base and unproven profitability durability are the key risks to watch.
